text:
maya_s: Quick sync  Acme wants a sandbox for their POC starting Mon. Requirements: workspace isolation, least-privilege invites for 6 contractor accounts + 2 product PMs, ephemeral API keys for contractors rotating daily, and a Dedicated pool for a 48-hr stress run in week 2. Also want a short-term pricing concession for the Dedicated trial. Who owns provisioning/runbook?

erin_devx: I can own onboarding docs & sample client for key refresh. Need the exact role names and invite mechanics from infra.

ravi_se: Ill own workspace and role setup. Plan: create workspace acme-poc, apply role templates mapped to our RBAC primitives, enable invite_expiry and ephemeral_key_policy, and create a routing policy to the Dedicated pool for perf tests.

lena_sec: Security notes: ephemeral keys ok if TTL <= 24h and refresh uses OAuth-like flow (no static secret stored). Enable audit logs + request_id per call, and require IP allowlist for Dedicated ingress. If they later ask for private/VPC, well exchange a KMS grant and prepare HSM/KMS policy. No long-lived service keys in plaintext.

alex_cust: Confirm isolation: contractors must not see other Acme projects or our internal org artifacts. Also want logs limited to their workspace.

ravi_se: Confirmed. Hosted API keys and workspace scoping isolate artifacts. I'll apply read-only log access for contractor_read and no billing access for contractor_invoke. PMs get workspace_admin for invites only (no org billing).

ops-bot: ticket-created: DEDICATED-BURST-2047 (requested 48h burst, priority: medium)

jon_sales: Pricing: finance prelim offer OK to give a prorated 3-week Dedicated trial with a one-time 25% commit discount. Need legal to sign a short addendum. I'll prep the commercial note.

maya_s: Good. Action items: 1) Ravi: terraform snippets + runbook for provisioning and invite flows, 2) Erin: sample key rotation client + onboarding checklist, 3) Lena: short security posture note and what to expect in audits, 4) Jon: commercial addendum draft. Please post artifacts in this thread.

ravi_se: Runbook summary posted below (tl;dr):
1) Create workspace `acme-poc`.
2) Create roles and bindings:
   - contractor_invoke -> invoke_only (no console, no billing)
   - contractor_read -> read_logs_console (console read, no write)
   - pm_workspace_admin -> invite_approve (invite + view only)
   Set `invite_expiry=14d` and `max_invites_per_user=5`.
3) Enable `ephemeral_key_policy` TTL=24h and `allow_refresh=true`.
4) Generate initial hosted API invite links for contractors and PMs.
5) Submit Dedicated pool burst request (ticket DEDICATED-BURST-2047). Include IP allowlist CIDRs and expected RPS.
6) Optional: prepare private/VPC + KMS path later (exchange KMS key policy).

Terraform snippet (minimal, sanitized):
```
resource "redwood_workspace" "acme_poc" { name = "acme-poc" retention = "14d" }
resource "redwood_role" "contractor_invoke" { name = "contractor_invoke" template = "invoke_only" }
resource "redwood_policy" "ephemeral" { workspace = redwood_workspace.acme_poc.id ttl = "24h" refresh = true }
```

erin_devx: I'll add a tiny node/python example to refresh keys using the refresh endpoint and a sample checklist: step 1: accept invite, step 2: run key-refresh script, step 3: run smoke tests against hosted endpoint, step 4: schedule Dedicated window.

lena_sec: I uploaded a short security note to the shared drive and pasted checklist highlights: enable request_id tracing, forward logs to customer's logging endpoint (if requested), enforce IP allowlist for Dedicated pool, ensure audit retention 90 days for POC.

ops-bot: support-note: ops-runbook link https://redwood.ops/poc-runbooks/1958001234

maya_s: Perfect. @alex_cust I'll send this thread plus the onboarding checklist. Alex, please confirm the CIDR blocks for the Dedicated run and whether you want us to set up the KMS exchange now or after the POC.

alex_cust: We'll provide CIDRs tomorrow. KMS exchange later if we decide to move to VPC. For now the hosted flow + Dedicated burst is fine. Also, can you confirm contractors cannot download logs with PII?

lena_sec: We'll mask PII in logs for the workspace and provide logs via secure link; contractor_read won't grant raw export permissions.

jon_sales: I'll attach the 25% trial discount in the term sheet and flag for legal review. Expected turnaround 48h.

maya_s: Thanks all  please post the terraform + client script in this thread when ready. I'll close once Acme confirms CIDRs and signs the addendum.
